description: Report only: fetches merge_group CI runs, their jobs and each queued PR's timeline through gh api (fetch), then reports per entry the wait before its run existed, the critical-path job, runner waits split macOS and Linux, outcomes, removals with their cause, and queue rebuilds where an entry was regrouped onto a new base (report, offline over the saved file). With --proof-reuse <dir> it also reads the proof-reuse shadow's daily roll-ups (proof-reuse-daily/1): runner time saved against the potential, unchecked numbers, cancelled runs and the critical-path time hits would have saved.
